english.title: Trader fail to provide information on pre-contractual matters to consumer
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a trader, failed, before entering into a regulated contract with a consumer, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to provide the consumer with key information in the standard information form completed in accordance with regulation 13(1) of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010, in writing, free of charge and in a manner which was easily accessible to the consumer
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(5) and (8) and 27 of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time Limit on Prosecutions;
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
